propositions: pip-audit gating job fails on every patchset against main due to click 8.2.1 matching advisory PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection in click.edit), blocking all Verified +1 votes
click 8.2.1 is locked transitively via inspect-ai ([eval] extra) which pins click <8.2.2; uv resolves all extras jointly so 8.2.1 is the newest click satisfying the constraint set
constraint-dependencies cannot lift the cap from inspect-ai; override-dependencies is the correct instrument to replace the requirement and permit click >=8.3.3
inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports cleanly and CLI executes under click 8.4.2 despite the declared cap, proving the cap is stale not a real incompatibility
fix is uv override-dependencies ["click>=8.3.3"] in pyproject.toml + relock to click 8.4.2; override is a workspace directive not published in wheel metadata so does not affect downstream consumers
fix landed on main as commit 31844d5f9fb; pip-audit now passes and gating is unblocked
